channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: 49ers LB Luke Gifford (hamstring) did not practice Saturday.
item.description: The special teams ace missed practice Saturday with what is calling a “hamstring issue,” with the further word on how serious the ailment is. Gifford earned his first Pro Bowl nod for his special teams play in 2025 while also starting nine games for the 49ers. Expect an update from the team in short order.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Ravens HC Jesse Minter said WR Zay Flowers (quadricep contusion) will miss some practice.
item.description: Flowers apparently avoided significant injury but will reportedly miss a “couple days” with a quadricep contusion suffered in practice Saturday. Camp injuries are beginning to flood in but it appears as if Flowers will be okay following a couple of days off. Entering his fourth season, there is real optimism that Flowers will take another step forward under a new coaching staff, although a career 15.7 percent red zone target rate could keep him from becoming a true fantasy star. For now, treat Flowers as a solid fourth round selection in fantasy drafts that carries elite spike-week potential due to his downfield role.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil (shoulder/neck) will undergo testing for injury.
item.description: The news was first reported by Mike Garafolo of NFL Network. Tunsil will be evaluated and tested for injury, but Garafolo says he’s not sensing huge panic about the injury. Still, Garafolo also said he wouldn’t be surprised if Tunsil has to miss some time. Stay tuned as the tests will ultimately show the severity of Tunsil’s injury.-Nick Shlain

item.title: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak told reporters that QB Kirk Cousins and EDGE Maxx Crosby are being held out of practice Saturday for violating team rules for fighting.
item.description: Cousins and Crosby got into it Friday with the 37-year-old quarterback taking exception after multiple hits from Crosby. Cousins got in Crosby’s face and grabbed his jersey as the two exchanged words before it was broken up. Both will sit out practice Saturday, but should be back on the field soon.-Nick Shlain

item.title: Eagles RT Lane Johnson told reporters this will “probably” be his last season.
item.description: Johnson was back at practice after being excused earlier in the week as he handled some personal business. Entering his 14th season in the NFL, Johnson told reporters this will probably be his final season. He cited his family as the primary motivation for potentially hanging up his cleats for the last time after this season. Johnson appeared in only 10 games last year, but was named either a first-team or second-team All-Pro in the four seasons prior to 2025.-Nick Shlain

item.title: Colts WR Josh Downs (groin) didn’t practice Saturday.
item.description: Reporters noticed Downs in street clothes on the sideline at the beginning of practice. He’s dealing with a groin injury, according to the team. There should be an update on Downs’ status following the conclusion of Saturday’s practice. For now, it’s not a great sign that Downs is dealing with an injury so close to the start of the regular season, though it’s unclear if he’s dealing with a long-term injury.-Nick Shlain

item.title: Colts RB DJ Giddens (hamstring) didn’t practice Saturday.
item.description: Giddens appeared to have the inside track on the No. 2 RB job behind Jonathan Taylor at the end of July. With Taylor out looking for a new contract, Giddens took the majority of first-team reps during minicamp. Now Giddens is out dealing with a hamstring injury and seventh-round rookie Seth McGowan is getting the reps behind Taylor. It could be an uphill battle for Giddens, who the Colts selected in the fifth-round in 2025, once he returns from injury.-Nick Shlain

item.title: Luther Burden (leg) limped to the locker room with a trainer at practice Saturday.
item.description: Burden got tangled with a defender and fell awkwardly during a one-on-one red zone drill at practice on Saturday. The 22-year-old wide receiver limped to the locker room slowly with a trainer. It’s unclear if Burden is dealing with a significant injury. We’ll continue to monitor the situation until more information is known.-Nick Shlain

item.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) didn’t practice Saturday.
item.description: Smith continues to miss practice with a hamstring injury. While the injury isn’t considered to be serious, the Eagles still aren’t going to push Smith in practice just yet. He figures to be the top target in the Eagles new offense under new OC Sean Mannion in the wake of the Eagles trading A.J. Brown this offseason.-Nick Shlain

item.title: Eagles WR Makai Lemon (hamstring) didn’t practice Saturday.
item.description: The good news: Eagles GM Howie Roseman didn’t seem overly concerned that Lemon wasn’t practicing during an interview with Kay Adams on Friday. Lemon also was seen catching passes from the JUGS machine on Saturday. Still, it’s the fourth consecutive missed practice for the rookie receiver who also missed time during minicamp. Lemon is starting from behind, but it’s important to remember how long the 17-game NFL season is. The Eagles will certainly need production from Lemon at some point as the team revises its passing attack without A.J. Brown.-Nick Shlain
